description: Statistical comparison of AAD3-branch dN/dS against control paralog pairs, and dS ranking
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
# counts from the Nei-Gojobori table above (Nd, Sd) for unsaturated pairs (dS < 1)
pairs={"AAD3-AAD14":(108.8,112.2),"AAD3-AAD4":(80.8,76.2),
       "AAD4-AAD14":(29.2,64.8),"AAD10-AAD14":(40.5,87.5),"AAD4-AAD10":(30.0,92.0)}
rows=[]
for a in ["AAD3-AAD14","AAD3-AAD4"]:
    for b in ["AAD4-AAD14","AAD10-AAD14","AAD4-AAD10"]:
        t=[[round(pairs[a][0]),round(pairs[a][1])],[round(pairs[b][0]),round(pairs[b][1])]]
        orr,p=fisher_exact(t)
        rows.append(dict(AAD3_pair=a,control_pair=b,table=str(t),odds_ratio=round(orr,3),
                         p=f"{p:.3g}", Nd_Sd_AAD3=round(pairs[a][0]/pairs[a][1],3),
                         Nd_Sd_ctrl=round(pairs[b][0]/pairs[b][1],3)))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows); print("Fisher exact on Nd vs Sd counts, AAD3-containing pairs vs control pairs:")
print(r.to_string(index=False))
r.to_csv("aad_paralog_dnds_fisher.csv",index=False)

# synonymous divergence shows the AAD3-AAD15 pair is far younger than any other pair
ds={"AAD3-AAD15":0.0445,"AAD4-AAD14":0.4085,"AAD4-AAD15":0.6367,"AAD14-AAD15":0.7304,
    "AAD10-AAD14":0.7587,"AAD3-AAD14":0.7809,"AAD4-AAD10":0.8364,"AAD3-AAD4":0.5517,
    "AAD3-AAD10":1.4217,"AAD10-AAD15":1.7049}
s=pd.Series(ds).sort_values()
print("\nSynonymous divergence dS between paralog pairs (Jukes-Cantor):")
print(s.round(3).to_string())
print(f"\nAAD3-AAD15 dS = {ds['AAD3-AAD15']:.4f}; next lowest = {s.iloc[1]:.4f} "
      f"({s.index[1]}), a {s.iloc[1]/ds['AAD3-AAD15']:.1f}-fold difference")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.5))
c=["#e86b6b" if k=="AAD3-AAD15" else "#6b93e8" for k in s.index]
ax.barh(s.index,s.values,color=c); ax.axvline(1.0,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("synonymous divergence dS (Jukes-Cantor); dS > 1 is saturated")
ax.set_title("AAD3 and AAD15 share a synonymous divergence 9-fold lower than any other paralog pair,\n"
             "the signature of a recent duplication or gene conversion",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
